violations.rule: Deadlock: Slave stalling WREADY waiting for BREADY
Deadlock: Master stalling BREADY waiting for WREADY

annotations.message: The Master has data to send (WVALID=1) but is refusing to accept responses (BREADY=0).
The Slave has responses to send (BVALID=1) but is refusing to accept data (WREADY=0).
Both sides are permanently stuck waiting for the other to move first. This is a fatal protocol violation. You cannot make VALID depend on READY.
